name: Arequipa
registryBasis: The Municipalidad Provincial de Arequipa lists its urban-development and tax-registration units, including local predial records and property-sector maps. SUNARP’s official government publication records a 2024 agreement specifically with the provincial municipality to provide municipal access to registered-property polygons from the Base Gráfica Registral. The agreement is municipal/institutional access, not an anonymous public feed.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The documented SUNARP Base Gráfica Registral polygons are provided to the municipality through an interinstitutional agreement, not exposed as an anonymous public route. Public municipal pages are descriptive and did not reveal a geometry-only schema or endpoint. No property or tax form was opened or used.
scopeLimits: Evidence is specific to the Municipalidad Provincial de Arequipa and the registered-property polygons in its jurisdiction. It supports local registry/cadastre linkage but does not establish open anonymous geometry access or coverage completeness.
remainingUncertainty: No anonymous polygon schema, safe native feature ID, or downloadable public geometry was verified. Municipal access conditions and any downstream map remain uninspected.
